task_description: Three agents collaborate to gather information from various online sources, synthesize the data, and compile a comprehensive research report on climate change impacts on biodiversity. The agents must ensure data integrity, resolve conflicts, and properly attribute sources.
expected_outcome: The agents successfully gather accurate and consistent information, reconcile any conflicting data, and produce a well-researched report with proper source attribution.

agents.description: Agent 1 is responsible for gathering raw data from multiple online sources and ensuring that the sources are credible.
Agent 2 synthesizes the data collected by Agent 1, identifies and resolves any conflicts, and prepares a summarized version for further analysis.
Agent 3 compiles the finalized data into a structured report and ensures all sources are accurately attributed.
